finalText: Migration's done. I moved the last 12 stale `db.query` call sites over to `db.execute({ sql, params })` across the catalog, support, accounts, billing, orders, and analytics packages. I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` and every `cache.query` call alone since those aren't part of the swap. The verifier confirms it: `OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved`.
